standard.summary: 大于 0 时，在优化步达到此步数后冻结文本编码器；0 表示关闭（不冻结）。需开启 ac_enable_auto_te_freeze 才生效。
standard.effect: 冻结后 TE 参数不再更新，后续步骤只训练 UNet/DiT 层。实际触发点不会早于 ac_warmup_steps。
standard.whenToUse: 通常设为总步数的 40%~60%。如总步数 500，可设为 200~300。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要全程训练 TE 时保持 0；设为 0 不会立即冻结。

standard_en.summary: When greater than 0, freezes the text encoder once the optimizer step reaches this value; 0 disables the freeze. Requires ac_enable_auto_te_freeze.
standard_en.effect: Frozen TE parameters stop updating and only the UNet/DiT layers keep training. The actual trigger never fires before ac_warmup_steps.
standard_en.whenToUse: Usually 40% to 60% of the total steps. With 500 total steps, 200 to 300 is a good choice.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Keep 0 when the TE should train for the whole run; 0 does not freeze immediately.

advanced.principle: step >= ac_te_freeze_step 且已过预热步数时触发一次性冻结：TE 参数 requires_grad=False，后续反向不再计算 TE 梯度。
advanced.tradeoffs: 需要与 train_text_encoder 联动，确认 TE 确实在前半段被训练。

advanced_en.principle: At step >= ac_te_freeze_step, after warmup, a one-shot freeze sets TE parameters requires_grad=False so later backward passes skip TE gradients.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Must be coordinated with train_text_encoder — confirm the TE really is trained in the first phase.
